definitions.gloss: Izumo Grand Shrine; major Shinto shrine in Shimane Prefecture
definitions.explanation: One of the most important and ancient Shinto shrines in Japan, located in Izumo, Shimane Prefecture. Dedicated to Ōkuninushi no Mikoto, the deity associated with marriage and relationships. A major pilgrimage destination.

examples.japanese: {出雲大社|いずもたいしゃ}は{縁結|えんむす}びで{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: Izumo Grand Shrine is famous for matchmaking.

examples.japanese: {島根|しまね}{県|けん}の{出雲大社|いずもたいしゃ}に{参拝|さんぱい}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to pay my respects at Izumo Grand Shrine in Shimane Prefecture.

examples.japanese: {出雲大社|いずもたいしゃ}では{二礼四拍手一礼|にれいしはくしゅいちれい}という{独特|どくとく}な{参拝|さんぱい}{作法|さほう}がある。
examples.english: Izumo Grand Shrine has a unique manner of worship: two bows, four claps, and one bow.

notes:
One of Japan's oldest shrines, said to predate the written historical record. Dedicated to {大国主命|おおくにぬしのみこと} (Ōkuninushi no Mikoto), a deity associated with agriculture, medicine, and especially {縁結|えんむす}び (forming connections, including romantic ones).

NOTABLE FEATURES:
- The shrine uses 二礼四拍手一礼 (two bows, four claps, one bow) rather than the standard 二礼二拍手一礼
- In the lunar tenth month ({神無月|かんなづき}), all the gods of Japan are said to gather at Izumo
- Features a massive {注連縄|しめなわ} (sacred rope)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出雲大社|いずもたいしゃ}に{参拝|さんぱい}する: to visit Izumo Grand Shrine
- {出雲大社|いずもたいしゃ}で{縁結|えんむす}びを{祈|いの}る: to pray for a match at Izumo
